title: G6 sensor errors
symptom: Getting G6 "sensor errors" and no BG results. Reboot, restart sensor not working. The issue persists and the fallback option keeps reverting to native mode.
cause: The G6 transmitter cuts the feed and sends sensor errors message, which seems to be a feature of the G6. The fallback option unchecks itself possibly due to being in native mode.
fix: Turn on the xdrip algo fallback option to see values. Some users found that toggling Bluetooth off/on, restarting collector and phone, and checking the fallback option helped after a few minutes, but it may revert.
evidence_quote: Turn on the xdrip algo fallback option if u need to see values.
